operating_notes.text: Raw material cost was 81.1% of Q4FY26 revenue against 77.6% in Q4FY25.
Inventories rose to ₹39.46 Cr at Mar-2026 from ₹23.99 Cr a year earlier.
The company operates a single segment under Ind AS 108.

timeline.summary: Jasjot Singh (MD) confirms no encumbrance on promoter shares held by Ajooni Biotech Limited, its group, or persons acting in concert for FY2026.
Ajooni Biotech appointed M/s. N. Kumar & Company as internal auditors for FY 2025-26 on May 21, 2026.
Jasjot Singh (MD) and promoter group declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹60.62 Cr (+107.1% YoY), net profit ₹0.95 Cr (-38.3% YoY).
